name: All of Us: Her Story
source:
The story focuses more on same-sex love interest routes and is about a group of queer friends trying to stop an LGBT coffee shop in San Francisco from being shut down.

[From [url=https://tvtropes.org/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/VisualNovel/AllOfUs]TV Tropes[/url]]
